rubric.why: Identifies hypertext as text containing links.
rubric.description: States that hypertext is text with links.
rubric.how: Award for explaining that links are part of or attached to the text.

rubric.why: Explains what the links connect to.
rubric.description: States that the links lead to other documents or web pages.
rubric.how: Award for identifying linked documents or pages as the destinations.

modelAnswer: Hypertext is text that contains links.
These links lead to other documents or web pages.

rubric.why: Identifies sabotage as a deliberate act.
rubric.how: Award for indicating that the act is done deliberately or on purpose.

rubric.why: Identifies the computer-related damage or disruption caused by sabotage.
rubric.description: States that sabotage damages or disrupts a computer system, network, data or services.
rubric.how: Award for naming an appropriate computer-related target or disruption.

modelAnswer: Sabotage is the deliberate act of damaging or disrupting a computer system, network or its data.
It can prevent the system or its services from working properly.
